_comment: Feature flag configuration - Meridian Health Technologies

new-scheduling-ui.description: New scheduling interface with drag-and-drop and multi-provider view
new-scheduling-ui.notes: Fully rolled out as of 2025-09-01. Can probably remove this flag.

patient-portal-v2.description: Redesigned patient portal with mobile-first approach
patient-portal-v2.notes: Ramping up. At 75% since Dec 2025. Some legacy orgs have custom CSS that breaks v2.

auto-eligibility-check.description: Automatically run eligibility check when appointment is booked
auto-eligibility-check.notes: Fully rolled out. TODO: remove flag and make this default behavior.

claim-auto-submit.description: Automatically submit claims when all required fields are complete
claim-auto-submit.notes: Active A/B test. See experiments/ab-tests/claim-auto-submit-test.ts for metrics.

dark-mode.description: Dark mode for the provider portal
dark-mode.notes: Internal only. We built this during a hack week. Design team hasn't approved it for general release.

fhir-r4-api.description: FHIR R4 API endpoints (replacing our custom REST API)
fhir-r4-api.notes: Orgs that have opted into FHIR R4 get the new endpoints. Others stay on v2 REST.

ai-coding-suggestions.description: AI-powered ICD-10 and CPT code suggestions during encounter documentation
ai-coding-suggestions.notes: ML team experiment. Using fine-tuned model for code suggestions. Accuracy metrics in /ml/experiments/coding-accuracy.ipynb

batch-claim-processing.description: Process claims in batches instead of one-at-a-time
batch-claim-processing.notes: Fully rolled out since July 2024. This should have been removed ages ago.

hl7-fhir-bridge.description: Bridge for translating HL7v2 messages to FHIR resources
hl7-fhir-bridge.notes: Only for hospital orgs that send HL7v2. Flag is stale - this is just how it works now. Nobody wants to touch the HL7 code.

maintenance-mode.description: Kill switch - shows maintenance page to all users
maintenance-mode.notes: EMERGENCY USE ONLY. Enable this during planned downtime or critical incidents. Bypassed by admin users.

two-factor-enforcement.description: Require 2FA for all users (not just admins)
two-factor-enforcement.notes: Compliance requirement. Fully enforced since March 2024. DO NOT DISABLE.

enhanced-audit-logging.description: Detailed audit logging for PHI access
enhanced-audit-logging.notes: This has been on for over 2 years. It's not really a feature flag anymore, it's just how the system works. Removing would be a compliance violation.

telehealth-waiting-room.description: Virtual waiting room for telehealth appointments
telehealth-waiting-room.notes: This was built during COVID but the third-party video service we integrated with (MedVideo) shut down in 2024. We switched to Twilio but never rebuilt the waiting room feature. Keeping the flag in case we revisit.

real-time-benefits-check.description: Real-time pharmacy benefits check during prescribing
real-time-benefits-check.notes: Integrates with Surescripts RTBC. Ramping slowly because the API has rate limits and costs per-transaction.
